Given as input a list of monomials for a degree d ≥ 4 homogeneous multilinear polynomial f with coefficients in {0, 1}, it is NP-hard to compute Sd−2,1,1 (f ). Proof. As in the proof of Lemma 12, consider an instance of the vertex cover (that is, 2-uniform hitting set) problem on a simple loopless graph G with vertex set V (G) = [n] and edge set E(G), where each edge is a 2-element subset of V (G).
